comparisons.finding: Inspected donor dispatch captures clicked inventory, item type and slot; resolves food stage and replaces the next stage in that slot or deletes the terminal item before healing/effects. Rust actual EatItemSlot retains claimed identity and uses strict selected debit/remainder. Full-bag exchange and refusal with a matching unselected duplicate are supported comparison obligations, separately tested.

Donor prepares special effects before item replacement, then applies healing/delays/secondary effects. Rust stages inventory and all Stats before publication, rejecting invalid later secondary effects without debit, heal or events. This is an explicit stronger local rollback policy, not an observed Kotlin failure-atomicity claim.

Pinned Shark15183388 establishes ordinary member385, Eat and20HP; exact target static catalog matches20. This single pinned page does not prove every static food value. Rust caps ordinary healing at live base and preserves pre-existing overheal. Donor delegates maximum-healing policy and supports special/PvP-dependent cases; those cannot be inferred accepted from the ordinary adapter.

Donor records distinct consumption/combat delays, resets facing and emits eating sound. Exact Rust adapter publishes animation/message/food delay; its optional multipart trace is not an attack-clock measurement. Existing ordinary local message and cake/pizza delay policy is an explicit adaptation. Rendered/audio behavior, exact combat cadence and area/activity parity remain open, rather than inferred from spaced native actions.

Rust trusted definition membership is checked before ordinary state mutation; do not infer a complete donor activity/access framework. Donor includes blighted Wilderness restriction, sweets run energy, dynamic/random healing and optional secondary effects. Later contracts own these mechanics; this unit does not certify them.
